hypothesis_source: 20-session highs on the leader watch list mean-revert at 10/20 days (v1 rest-then-pop and v2 rolling new high both worse than untriggered leaders). Mechanism of those failures: buying strength already at a month high. Replacement: an inside bar (range inside the prior bar) then a close above that inside high. That is a two-bar compression-then-expansion, not a Donchian N-day high and not VCP.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a 20-day window scan. Not VCP/cup/flag. Not all-market trend_breakout. Not sequence-2 buy-all. Difference from v1/v2: trigger is leaving a one-bar enclosed range, not leaving a 20-session high.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31. Labels must not cross 2022-12-31.

trigger.definition: Bar t-1 is inside bar t-2 (high[t-1] <= high[t-2] and low[t-1] >= low[t-2], all finite and positive). Signal bar t close > high[t-1]. Calendar lag on the market session axis. Missing prior bars do not trigger.

control: Same-day watch-list names without that inside-bar breakout.

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of the trigger subset is not worse than same-day watch names without the trigger.
pass_fail.fail: Rewrite only this inside-bar event (one mechanistic change) or stop it and pick another non-20d-high, non-VCP breakout. Stay on layer 3. Do not skip to pullback as the selector.
